terms.comment: Portuguese caldo verde, the rendering in Libellus III.
The diminutive of jūs; the lexicon gives it, after Traupman, for a sauce.

phrases.latin: Domum reversa avia jūs coxit, quod Lūsitānī caldo verde vocant, id est jūs viride
phrases.english: Back home, Grandma made the soup the Portuguese call caldo verde, that is, green soup
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

phrases.latin: In culīnā jūs ex holeribus in ōllā foculō impositā calēbat, quod in crāstinum servātum est.
phrases.english: In the kitchen a vegetable soup was keeping warm in a pot on the stove; it was kept for the next day.
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: Lewis & Short: jus
